data.title: Arthur Hayes Names Ethereum His ‘No. 1 Crypto Pick’, Sees ETH Surging 3X To 5X ‘Pretty Quickly’
data.description: Arthur Hayes added that Bitcoin could also reach $1 million over the next four years, citing the potential for massive money printing and U.S. yield-curve control.
